guarantees.claim: event_error is driven as the bitwise OR of sha3_err.valid, app_err.valid, entropy_err.valid, and errchecker_err.valid.
hw2reg.err_code.de is assigned to the combinational value of event_error.

assumptions.claim: The signals sha3_err.valid, app_err.valid, entropy_err.valid, errchecker_err.valid are glitch-free and correctly reflect error conditions only when a true error occurs.
assumptions.cond: when any error condition occurs, the corresponding valid signal must be asserted without spurious glitches.
assumptions.risk: Glitches or transient spikes may cause a false event_error pulse, leading to erroneous latching of hw2reg.err_code and potentially reporting a false error condition that could affect system integrity or security response.

uncertain_points.claim: If hw2reg.err_code.de is expected to capture only once per error event, a persistent level on event_error (due to sticky error valid signals) may enable continuous updating of the error code register, potentially overwriting earlier error information.
uncertain_points.cond: When any of the four error valid signals remains asserted for multiple clock cycles and the downstream logic relies on edge-triggered capture.
uncertain_points.risk: The error code may be overwritten, losing the first error source, complicating fault diagnosis or allowing a transient to mask a persistent fault, which could have security implications in a cryptographic IP.
